description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1996, operating 13+ locations across the city and known for in-house small-batch roasted organic coffee and award-winning New York-style cheesecakes made fresh daily. This Granville Street branch is one of two the chain operates on that corridor in the heart of downtown Vancouver. Cyclists passing through the city core will find a full cafe menu of sandwiches, baked goods, and teas alongside the signature coffee and cheesecake.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 100m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a cafe at 738 Granville Street with diet:vegetarian=yes and indoor_seating=yes tags. The website confirms Trees is an active multi-location chain (13–14 Vancouver locations) serving organic coffee, cheesecakes, sandwiches, and baked goods, with online ordering and in-store pickup available. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging for this specific location, so those remain null per evidence rules.
